what: New awk lint is not added to the enforced pre-commit surface
scenario_or_breakage: CI runs make lint-only, while the plan only wires lint-awk-multibyte-regex into local make lint; the harness proves fixtures but the actual repo scan can be skipped on PRs
suggested_fix: Add a local pre-commit hook beside lint-bare-grep-probe with pass_filenames false and always_run true, or otherwise make the CI lint job invoke the new repo scan
